summary: Full E2E testing of postcardsandpoetry landing page. 6/6 pytest backend tests passed (root brand message, contact create with valid+invalid+missing payloads, list sorted desc, no _id leak). Frontend desktop verified all required data-testids (nav, hero, books, poems, shop, footer, contact form). Contact form happy-path POST /api/contact succeeds with sonner success toast, empty-form validation shows error toast without API call. Mobile (390x800) menu toggle opens drawer, clicking nav-link-mobile-books closes menu and smooth-scrolls (scrollY 1364 == #books offsetTop 1364). Amazon shop links open in new tab with amazon.com href. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact GET endpoint is publicly readable and unauthenticated - any visitor could enumerate all contact submissions. Consider adding auth or removing the GET endpoint from public exposure for production.
Hero ocean background image fetched cross-origin from unsplash on every load - consider lazy load or self-hosting for resilience.
Backend POST /contact wraps insert in try/except that swallows the exception type and always returns 500 - fine for now but lose granularity if Mongo validation differs from EmailStr.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth flows in app
seed_data_creation: Test contact messages with TEST_ prefix inserted into contact_messages collection via API during pytest run (not cleaned up - leftover TEST_* docs may persist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py. Mongo collection contact_messages contains TEST_* seed docs. All required data-testids confirmed present and working. No auth in app. Toaster is from 'sonner' (top-right).
